# remocn

> shadcn registry of production-ready Remotion components — animations, transitions, backgrounds, and full scenes. Install with `npx shadcn add remocn/<component>`.

Docs are also available as raw Markdown: append `.md` to any docs URL, or read [/llms-full.txt](https://remocn.dev/llms-full.txt) for the full corpus in a single file.

Building a video? Start at [/llms-components.txt](https://remocn.dev/llms-components.txt) — every installable component in one table with its use / avoid signal, natural length, vibe and dependencies, linking to each component's full page.

Prefer an app to a terminal? [Remocn Studio](https://remocn.studio) is a free, open-source macOS app where the user's own coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot or Grok) builds Remotion videos from remocn components, with a live preview and export. Its own index is at [remocn.studio/llms.txt](https://remocn.studio/llms.txt).

## Components
- [Components](https://remocn.dev/docs/components.md): Every component in remocn, grouped by category

## Ai
- [Agent Run](https://remocn.dev/docs/ai/agent-run.md): A brand-neutral AI agent run that thinks, calls tools against a real-seconds timer and streams a markdown answer in bursts
- [ChatGPT](https://remocn.dev/docs/ai/chat-gpt.md): Animated ChatGPT composer that types a prompt and morphs the voice button into a send button
- [Claude Chat](https://remocn.dev/docs/ai/claude-chat.md): Animated Claude chat input that types a prompt and morphs the waveform button into a send button
- [Claude Code](https://remocn.dev/docs/ai/claude-code.md): Animated Claude Code CLI welcome screen that types a command into the terminal prompt
- [AI](https://remocn.dev/docs/ai.md): Animated AI tool interfaces — chat composers and CLI welcome screens that type a prompt, and an agent run that streams the answer
- [OpenCode](https://remocn.dev/docs/ai/opencode.md): Animated OpenCode TUI welcome screen that types a query into the input
- [v0](https://remocn.dev/docs/ai/v0.md): Animated Vercel v0 composer that types a prompt and morphs the mic button into a send button

## Camera
- [Cloth Reveal](https://remocn.dev/docs/camera/cloth-reveal.md): A satin sheet draped over your content is yanked from one corner, folding and fluttering as a simulated cloth before it clears the frame
- [Dolly Zoom](https://remocn.dev/docs/camera/dolly-zoom.md): The vertigo shot, a corridor with a red door stretches deeper while the subject in the middle keeps its exact size
- [Exploded View](https://remocn.dev/docs/camera/exploded-view.md): An isometric stack of slabs springs apart with leader lines and labels, holds, then clicks back together
- [Gravity Pile](https://remocn.dev/docs/camera/gravity-pile.md): Seeded circles, squares and triangles rain down, bounce off the floor and each other, and settle into a heap, with optional content of your own landing on top
- [Impact Shake](https://remocn.dev/docs/camera/impact-shake.md): Heavy content slams down from above with a squash, a damped camera jolt, a two-frame RGB split and dust puffs kicking out sideways
- [Camera & Physics](https://remocn.dev/docs/camera.md): Full-frame shots built on a simulated camera or a small physics engine, from parallax trucks and a dolly zoom to falling bodies and a cloth yank
- [Parallax Depth](https://remocn.dev/docs/camera/parallax-depth.md): A layered landscape trucks sideways with a gentle push-in, near layers sliding faster than far ones, through a pinhole camera you can fill with your own layers
- [Tiny Planet](https://remocn.dev/docs/camera/tiny-planet.md): A seeded flat skyline bends into a tiny planet through a polar remap, then keeps turning beside a red sun
- [Turntable](https://remocn.dev/docs/camera/turntable.md): A product card with real thickness spins on an invisible turntable through front, edge and back, with face shading, a moving sheen and a floor shadow

## Compositions
- [Ecosystem Constellation](https://remocn.dev/docs/compositions/ecosystem-constellation.md): A central product logo orbited by integration satellites with pulsing data lines
- [Compositions](https://remocn.dev/docs/compositions.md): Full scenes built by composing primitives and UI blocks
- [Infinite Bento Pan](https://remocn.dev/docs/compositions/infinite-bento-pan.md): A hypnotic diagonal camera glide over an oversized grid of bento cards
- [Live Code Compilation](https://remocn.dev/docs/compositions/live-code-compilation.md): A split-screen where code is typed on the left and the right-side UI snaps to match in a single frame

## Craft
- [Anti-patterns](https://remocn.dev/docs/craft/anti-patterns.md): The dozen mistakes that recur when a video is generated, each with the fix beside it
- [Design defaults](https://remocn.dev/docs/craft/design-defaults.md): Restraint rules for the text, chrome and cards you add yourself, plus the palette and fonts the library already uses
- [Craft](https://remocn.dev/docs/craft.md): The house rules behind a remocn video — restraint in design, intent in motion, and the mistakes that give a generated video away
- [Motion principles](https://remocn.dev/docs/craft/motion-principles.md): The classic animation principles reduced to the eight that matter when you assemble scenes from prebuilt blocks

## Effects
- [Confetti](https://remocn.dev/docs/effects/confetti.md): Deterministic confetti burst for Remotion — seeded particles with gravity, spin, and flutter
- [Crumple Toss](https://remocn.dev/docs/effects/crumple-toss.md): Crushes an element into a ball of paper and throws it out of frame
- [Cursor Gravity](https://remocn.dev/docs/effects/cursor-gravity.md): A rounded triangular cursor tugs a button out of the screen edge with pulsed elastic resistance
- [Effects](https://remocn.dev/docs/effects.md): Reusable Remotion effect overlays for celebratory and atmospheric moments
- [Ink Arrow](https://remocn.dev/docs/effects/ink-arrow.md): A hand-drawn arrow that draws itself from one point to another in stop-motion poses
- [Keystroke](https://remocn.dev/docs/effects/keystroke.md): Physical keycaps that press, hold and spring back in real order, a shortcut overlay for keyboard-first product demos
- [Paper Wobble](https://remocn.dev/docs/effects/paper-wobble.md): Per-pose reshoot jitter that makes any content feel hand-placed on a desk
- [Radial Burst](https://remocn.dev/docs/effects/radial-burst.md): Sculptural ribbons twist into a tilted ring and sweep outward through layered contour echoes
- [Scribble Circle](https://remocn.dev/docs/effects/scribble-circle.md): A brush circle that sweeps itself around a region of the frame, opening thin and closing thick
- [Simulated Cursor](https://remocn.dev/docs/effects/simulated-cursor.md): A synthetic mouse cursor that travels between waypoints and fires a click ripple, for narrating a UI on screen
- [TV Power Off](https://remocn.dev/docs/effects/tv-power-off.md): End a scene the way a tube does — the picture collapses into a glowing line, pinches to a phosphor dot, and the frame is left dead black

## Getting Started
- [Agent Skill](https://remocn.dev/docs/getting-started/agent-skill.md): Install the remocn agent skill with skills.sh so your AI generates better Remotion videos
- [Installation](https://remocn.dev/docs/getting-started/installation.md): Add remocn to an existing Remotion project
- [Introduction](https://remocn.dev/docs/getting-started/introduction.md): What remocn is — a shadcn-style component registry for Remotion plus an agent skill. Copy-paste video components, MIT, code lives in your repo.
- [Plugin](https://remocn.dev/docs/getting-started/plugin.md): Install the remocn plugin for Claude Code or Codex. It turns a one-line brief into a Remotion video built from remocn components, checks the frames, and opens the result in Remocn Studio.

## Graphic Looks
- [Blueprint](https://remocn.dev/docs/graphic-looks/blueprint.md): A product wipes left to right into a technical drawing with a blueprint grid, white linework, dimension lines and a red callout
- [Brick Mosaic](https://remocn.dev/docs/graphic-looks/brick-mosaic.md): Toy bricks drop in row by row from the bottom with a small bounce and build a pixel-art image on a baseplate
- [Comic Panels](https://remocn.dev/docs/graphic-looks/comic-panels.md): The frame cracks into a three-panel comic page with speed lines and halftone, then the action panel bursts into a full-frame POW
- [Duotone Beat](https://remocn.dev/docs/graphic-looks/duotone-beat.md): A two-ink halftone portrait that swaps its ink pair on every beat, punches in on the downbeat and shows a bar indicator
- [Graphic Looks](https://remocn.dev/docs/graphic-looks.md): Full-frame scenes that borrow a print, drawing or screen technique, from risograph plates and blueprints to heat cameras and toy bricks
- [Line Boil](https://remocn.dev/docs/graphic-looks/line-boil.md): A hand-drawn outline draws itself, boils on threes like a cel animation, and fills with color while it keeps boiling
- [Long Shadow](https://remocn.dev/docs/graphic-looks/long-shadow.md): A flat icon pops in and casts a long shadow to the frame edge, then the light swings and the shadow sweeps around on a spring
- [Riso Print](https://remocn.dev/docs/graphic-looks/riso-print.md): Print a subject in two risograph inks, with the accent plate sliding in off-register and settling a hair out of alignment over grainy paper
- [Synthwave](https://remocn.dev/docs/graphic-looks/synthwave.md): A retro neon horizon with a scrolling perspective grid, a rising striped sun and mountain ranges that slide in
- [X-Ray Scan](https://remocn.dev/docs/graphic-looks/x-ray-scan.md): A glowing scanner bar sweeps across a device and reveals its white-line internals, with one part marked in red

## Guides
- [Changelog video](https://remocn.dev/docs/guides/changelog-video.md): A ~25-second release update for the weeks that ship several small things — same open, same pace, every release
- [Directing your agent](https://remocn.dev/docs/guides/directing-your-agent.md): The first cut is a draft — how to get from there to the video you meant
- [Exporting your video](https://remocn.dev/docs/guides/exporting-your-video.md): The preview in your browser is not a file yet — one prompt turns it into an mp4 you can post
- [Feature announcement](https://remocn.dev/docs/guides/feature-announcement.md): A ~40-second release video that shows the feature working — the one we shipped remocn/ui with
- [How a video is built](https://remocn.dev/docs/guides/how-a-video-is-built.md): Think in beats — the one mental model behind every video you'll make
- [Guides](https://remocn.dev/docs/guides.md): Finished videos you can make yours — pick one, fill in your words, paste a prompt
- [Launch video](https://remocn.dev/docs/guides/launch-video.md): The ~35-second launch video we made for remocn itself — with your product in it
- [Music and sound](https://remocn.dev/docs/guides/music-and-sound.md): The recipes produce silent videos — a music bed is the cheapest upgrade that makes one feel finished
- [One video, three formats](https://remocn.dev/docs/guides/one-video-three-formats.md): Every recipe builds a horizontal video — Reels, Shorts and TikTok want vertical, and you re-cut instead of rebuilding
- [Product demo](https://remocn.dev/docs/guides/product-demo.md): A ~50-second video where your product is on camera doing its job — one flow, start to finish
- [Setup](https://remocn.dev/docs/guides/setup.md): One-time setup for making videos with an AI agent — about ten minutes
- [Showcase reel](https://remocn.dev/docs/guides/showcase-reel.md): A fast ~30-second reel where every item in a collection gets its own beat — the one we shipped the typography wave with
- [Teaser](https://remocn.dev/docs/guides/teaser.md): The ~15-second pre-launch video — something is coming, here is its name, here is the date
- [Words on screen](https://remocn.dev/docs/guides/words-on-screen.md): Video copy is not website copy — how to write lines people can read in two seconds
- [Your brand](https://remocn.dev/docs/guides/your-brand.md): Hand your brand to the agent once — every video after that comes out looking like yours

## Icons
- [Gallery](https://remocn.dev/docs/icons/gallery.md): Browse every remocn icon, hover to play its motion, and copy the install command

## Layout
- [Backdrop](https://remocn.dev/docs/layout/backdrop.md): Full-frame fill with an optional rounded, shadowed content frame — accepts a color, gradient, image, or any React element as a live animated background
- [Chat to Preview Layout](https://remocn.dev/docs/layout/chat-to-preview-layout.md): A two-column split where the chat column shrinks and the preview column expands, for showing an agent building something
- [Drift](https://remocn.dev/docs/layout/drift.md): Wrap any scene in a slow camera push-in so no frame is ever static
- [Layout](https://remocn.dev/docs/layout.md): Scene framing and fill components for Remotion compositions
- [Stage](https://remocn.dev/docs/layout/stage.md): Put a screenshot, recording, or long page on a perspective studio plane and direct the camera across it with timeline keyframes

## Logo Stings
- [Accordion Unfold](https://remocn.dev/docs/logo-stings/accordion-unfold.md): A tight paper zigzag unfolds sideways into a flat card with the logo printed across it
- [Anamorphic Flare](https://remocn.dev/docs/logo-stings/anamorphic-flare.md): A point of light stretches into a cinematic horizontal streak that sweeps the frame and reveals the logo behind it
- [Logo Stings](https://remocn.dev/docs/logo-stings.md): Short brand reveals that land your logo or wordmark at the open or close of a video
- [Inflate](https://remocn.dev/docs/logo-stings/inflate.md): A flat sliver puffs up like a balloon toy, squashes and settles into a glossy mark, then the wordmark slides out
- [Liquid Fill](https://remocn.dev/docs/logo-stings/liquid-fill.md): A drop falls into an outlined mark and liquid rises with a sloshing surface and bubbles until the mark is solid
- [Neon Sign](https://remocn.dev/docs/logo-stings/neon-sign.md): A glass neon tube stutters alive segment by segment, buzzes off once, then holds lit with a glow on the wall
- [Orbit Lock](https://remocn.dev/docs/logo-stings/orbit-lock.md): Moons ride tilted, shrinking orbits into a core that bursts into a ring flash, and the logo springs into place
- [Puzzle Snap](https://remocn.dev/docs/logo-stings/puzzle-snap.md): Geometric pieces spin in from scattered positions and snap into a mark with sparks, then the wordmark slides out beside it
- [Spotlight](https://remocn.dev/docs/logo-stings/spotlight.md): A soft stage spotlight searches the dark, overshoots, lands on the logo, and the house lights come up

## Motion Graphics
- [Bauhaus Build](https://remocn.dev/docs/motion-graphics/bauhaus-build.md): Flat shapes tumble corner over corner into a Bauhaus frieze, then rebuild around an open band that hands off to a title
- [Flow Field](https://remocn.dev/docs/motion-graphics/flow-field.md): Hundreds of particles ride a seeded, slowly changing vector field and leave fine fading trails, as a seamless loop
- [Motion Graphics](https://remocn.dev/docs/motion-graphics.md): Flat geometric motion-graphics pieces for openers, section breaks, and pattern beds
- [Isometric Build](https://remocn.dev/docs/motion-graphics/isometric-build.md): An isometric tile grid springs up row by row into a stepped block sculpture with one accent tower, then holds
- [Life Grid](https://remocn.dev/docs/motion-graphics/life-grid.md): Conway's Game of Life runs on a seeded grid, newborn cells flashing in the accent and dying cells shrinking away
- [Mondrian Split](https://remocn.dev/docs/motion-graphics/mondrian-split.md): Black lines cut the frame into a De Stijl grid, primaries fill the cells, the grid reflows like rubber, and one cell grows until it is the frame
- [Pendulum Wave](https://remocn.dev/docs/motion-graphics/pendulum-wave.md): A row of pendulums with tuned periods drifts from a straight line into travelling waves and braids, then realigns, as a seamless loop
- [Phyllotaxis](https://remocn.dev/docs/motion-graphics/phyllotaxis.md): Seeds spiral out at the golden angle into a sunflower head, then one Fibonacci arm turns accent and pulses outward while the head slowly turns
- [Speed Lines](https://remocn.dev/docs/motion-graphics/speed-lines.md): Parallel streaks trail an element at its real speed and die as it lands with a squash and a small bounce, or radial lines snap onto one point for a manga impact frame
- [Squiggle](https://remocn.dev/docs/motion-graphics/squiggle.md): A flat line draws itself along a straight course while its wave swims forward and calms, then erases toward the end
- [String Art](https://remocn.dev/docs/motion-graphics/string-art.md): Threads are strung around a ring of pins as a times table, then the multiplier morphs the figure from a cardioid through a nephroid and beyond
- [Topo Lines](https://remocn.dev/docs/motion-graphics/topo-lines.md): Topographic contour lines around a few seeded peaks breathe and drift, with index contours and one line picked out in the accent, as a seamless loop
- [Trim Burst](https://remocn.dev/docs/motion-graphics/trim-burst.md): Short strokes shoot out from a point and vanish in flight, each start chasing its end, to punctuate a click, a landing number or a beat
- [Truchet Flip](https://remocn.dev/docs/motion-graphics/truchet-flip.md): Quarter-circle tiles snap a quarter turn as a wave crosses the grid, reconnecting the lines until they settle into rings, a calm field, or a circle

## Social
- [GitHub Sponsors](https://remocn.dev/docs/social/github-sponsors.md): Animated GitHub Sponsors lockup — a self-drawing heart that docks to a header, every sponsor avatar blur-staggering into a grid, then a thank-you headline and a CTA
- [GitHub Stars](https://remocn.dev/docs/social/github-stars.md): Stargazer list fly-through with a synced odometer counter — renders standalone from sample data or accepts live stargazer props
- [Social](https://remocn.dev/docs/social.md): Remotion compositions for sharing milestones and social proof
- [Logo Enter](https://remocn.dev/docs/social/logo-enter.md): A stacked group of round brand chips that spring in one-by-one, then hold
- [X Follow Card](https://remocn.dev/docs/social/x-follow-card.md): Animated X profile follow card with spring bounce-in, staggered blur-in, and cursor-driven Follow transition
- [X Followers Overview](https://remocn.dev/docs/social/x-followers-overview.md): X follow notifications flip through in 3D, then the total follower count blurs in

- [Workflow Console](https://remocn.dev/docs/templates/workflow-console.md): An independent release-automation film with typed commands, environment diagrams, and pipeline metrics

## Ui
- [Concepts](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/concepts.md): The mental model behind remocn-ui primitives — atoms, timeline hooks, theming, and core exports
- [Introduction](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui.md): shadcn-style primitives scripted on the Remotion timeline
- [Installation](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/installation.md): Add remocn-ui primitives to an existing Remotion project via the shadcn CLI
- [AI Prompt Flow](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/blocks/ai-prompt-flow.md): A full prompt-to-answer scene — the prompt types itself, the button runs to loading, a skeleton reveals, and the answer crossfades in
- [Chat Flow](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/blocks/chat-flow.md): A messaging conversation that types outgoing messages, shows typing indicators, and pops in incoming replies with reactions
- [CheckoutFlow](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/blocks/checkout-flow.md): A cursor-driven checkout card with a pricing toggle, card input, terms checkbox, and payment confirmation
- [iMessage Chat Flow](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/blocks/imessage-chat-flow.md): iMessage-styled conversation with gray incoming and blue outgoing bubbles, typing indicator, Delivered label, and tapback reactions
- [Blocks](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/blocks.md): Full video scenes assembled from remocn-ui primitives
- [Onboarding Stepper Flow](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/blocks/onboarding-stepper-flow.md): A multi-step onboarding scene where a stepper advances through form panels and finishes on a success state
- [SettingsToggleFlow](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/blocks/settings-toggle-flow.md): Two-column settings card with a blur-in entrance and a cursor-driven switch, select, slider, and save
- [SignupFlow](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/blocks/signup-flow.md): A cursor-driven signup card — labeled fields fill top-to-bottom, then submit with success feedback
- [Telegram Chat Flow](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/blocks/telegram-chat-flow.md): Telegram-styled conversation with tailed bubbles, delivery checks, typing status, and reaction chips
- [Accordion](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/accordion.md): An accordion panel whose open/closed state is a pure function of the timeline
- [AlertDialog](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/alert-dialog.md): A modal alert dialog whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline
- [Blur In](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/blur-in.md): A wrapper that reveals a single child with blur, opacity, and a directional offset
- [Button](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/button.md): A button whose visual state is a pure function of the timeline
- [Caret](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/caret.md): A blinking text caret — a pure motion atom or a fully controlled bar
- [Checkbox](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/checkbox.md): A checkbox whose checked/unchecked state is a pure function of the timeline
- [Combobox](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/combobox.md): A searchable select with a typed-query input, filtered panel, and row selection
- [Command Menu](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/command-menu.md): A keyboard-driven command palette with backdrop, typing animation, and row selection
- [Context Menu](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/context-menu.md): A right-click menu panel that opens at the cursor point with no built-in trigger
- [Cursor](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/cursor.md): An animated cursor that follows a scripted path with click ripple and press effects
- [Dialog](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/dialog.md): A modal dialog whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline
- [Drawer](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/drawer.md): A bottom panel whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline
- [DropdownMenu](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/dropdown-menu.md): A dropdown menu container with opened/closed states and action rows
- [Field](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/field.md): A static layout family for composing labeled form controls with consistent vertical spacing
- [Input](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/input.md): An input field whose visual state is a pure function of the timeline
- [Message Bubble](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/message-bubble.md): A state-driven speech bubble with incoming and outgoing variants and an optional reaction badge
- [Popover](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/popover.md): A floating card that appears beside an anchor with arbitrary content
- [Progress](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/progress.md): A progress bar that fills along a scripted numeric value timeline
- [Radio](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/radio.md): A radio whose checked/unchecked state is a pure function of the timeline
- [Resizable](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/resizable.md): A two-panel split container whose divider ratio and handle state are driven by a scripted dual-channel timeline
- [Select Menu](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/select-menu.md): A vertical option list whose highlight slides between selections on the timeline
- [Select](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/select.md): A dropdown select container with opened/closed states and item panel
- [Sheet](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/sheet.md): A side panel whose opened/closed state is a pure function of the timeline
- [Skeleton Block](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/skeleton-block.md): A single shimmer placeholder rectangle whose highlight sweep is a pure function of the frame
- [Skeleton](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/skeleton.md): A shimmer placeholder that crossfades to real content when loaded
- [Slider](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/slider.md): A range slider with a draggable thumb driven by a scripted value and thumb-state timeline
- [Spinner](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/spinner.md): A deterministic spinning arc — pure function of the Remotion frame
- [Stepper](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/stepper.md): A multi-step progress indicator that advances along a scripted numeric position timeline
- [Switch](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/switch.md): A switch whose checked/unchecked state is a pure function of the timeline
- [Tabs](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/tabs.md): A tabs widget whose active-tab state is a pure function of the timeline
- [Toast](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/toast.md): A notification that slides in from below, holds, then auto-dismisses
- [Toggle Group](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/toggle-group.md): A segmented control whose active value slides a thumb indicator between segments
- [Tooltip](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/tooltip.md): A small floating label that appears above an anchor on hover
- [Typing Indicator](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui/components/typing-indicator.md): A motion atom that renders N bouncing dots driven directly by useCurrentFrame

## Ui Blocks
- [Animated Bar Chart](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui-blocks/animated-bar-chart.md): Bars spring up from the baseline with a staggered cascade
- [Animated Line Chart](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui-blocks/animated-line-chart.md): A line chart whose path draws on from left to right
- [Check List](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui-blocks/check-list.md): A handwritten checklist that writes itself out, then ticks and strikes through every done item
- [Code Morph](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui-blocks/code-morph.md): A code panel morphs between versions of a file, with surviving tokens gliding to their new line and column while removed code dissolves and new code fades in
- [Glass Code Block](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui-blocks/glass-code-block.md): A premium frosted-glass code editor window with a regex tokenizer and line-by-line stagger reveal
- [Glass Code Walk](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui-blocks/glass-code-walk.md): A camera that scans a glass code block top to bottom as it types, then pulls back to a centered hold
- [UI Blocks](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui-blocks.md): Pre-assembled interface elements like code editors, layouts, charts, and workflow visualizations
- [Paper Sticker](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui-blocks/paper-sticker.md): A taped paper chip that slaps onto the scene over two stop-motion poses
- [Polaroid](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui-blocks/polaroid.md): An instant-photo frame with a handwritten caption for video, images, or live compositions
- [Reel](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui-blocks/reel.md): A fixed centered card where images stack on the z-axis and each blooms open over the last
- [Search Reveal](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui-blocks/search-reveal.md): Construction circles expand into a search field, type your product name, and reveal an abstract graphic panel
- [Terminal Cursor Zoom](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui-blocks/terminal-cursor-zoom.md): Camera locked to the typing cursor, dollying across a terminal as a command types at high zoom
- [Terminal Simulator](https://remocn.dev/docs/ui-blocks/terminal-simulator.md): A console window that types out commands and rolls older lines off the top

## Transitions
- [ASCII Dissolve](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/ascii-dissolve.md): Dissolve one scene into the next through a drifting field of ASCII glyphs
- [Caret Wipe](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/caret-wipe.md): Sweep a typing caret across the frame, wiping the outgoing scene into the next
- [Displacement](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/displacement.md): Shear the frame into a grid of offset colour-fringed tiles under film grain and let them settle back on the next scene
- [Dither Dissolve](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/dither-dissolve.md): Dissolve one scene into the next through a drifting field of dither pixels
- [Ember Burn](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/ember-burn.md): Set the outgoing frame on fire so it boils, chars, and blows away as sparks that carry its own colour
- [Focus Pull](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/focus-pull.md): Rack focus from one scene to the next through a soft defocus breath
- [Glitch Cut](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/glitch-cut.md): Tear a hard cut into displaced slices with channel split and corrupted blocks
- [Grain Dissolve](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/grain-dissolve.md): Disintegrate the outgoing scene into soft grainy shapes and condense the next scene out of the noise
- [Grid Wave](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/grid-wave.md): Send a wave across the frame that raises the picture into a grid of solid blocks and sets them back down carrying the next scene
- [Hyperspace](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/hyperspace.md): Stretch a starfield into radial streaks, tunnel forward through the scene and land on the next one through a white flash
- [Icon Scatter](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/icon-scatter.md): Scatter a field of icons over the cut, hiding the scene swap at the field's peak
- [Transitions](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions.md): Scene transitions built as presentations for TransitionSeries
- [Iris Wipe](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/iris-wipe.md): Close a cartoon iris on the subject, hold it as a dot for a beat, then open it on the next scene
- [Lens Zoom](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/lens-zoom.md): A hard cut disguised as a lens punch-in — barrel distortion, zoom blur, chromatic split and camera shake around the splice
- [Light Leak](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/light-leak.md): Drift a warm analog light leak across the frame, blow it out at the cut and cool off on the next scene
- [Page Turn](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/page-turn.md): The exiting scene swings up and away like a notebook page in stop-motion poses
- [Paper Tear](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/paper-tear.md): Rip the frame down the middle and fling both halves apart with fibrous torn edges, revealing the scene underneath
- [Particle Dissolve](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/particle-dissolve.md): Grind the frame into drifting grey dust and let the next scene coalesce back out of it
- [Perlin Dissolve](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/perlin-dissolve.md): Sweep a perlin-noise threshold across the frame to dissolve into the next scene
- [Pixel Sort](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/pixel-sort.md): Melt the scene into glowing vertical streaks like glitch-art pixel sorting, then drop the next scene in column by column
- [Push Through](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/push-through.md): Dolly through the outgoing scene while the next one approaches from the depth
- [Ripple Zoom](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/ripple-zoom.md): Fly the camera through the center of grainy ripple rings while the next scene approaches from the depth
- [Shader Seam](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/shader-seam.md): Reveal an OpenShaders material, then dissolve it in place to uncover the next scene
- [Shader Spiral Pass](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/shader-spiral-pass.md): Fly into the hero spiral and emerge through its soft center into the next scene
- [Slide Swap](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/slide-swap.md): Shove one scene off the canvas and spring the next in from the opposite edge
- [Smoke Dissolve](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/smoke-dissolve.md): Expand a smoke ring outward across the frame to reveal the next scene
- [Spring Settle](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/spring-settle.md): Shrink a scene away as one group, hold the stage empty for a beat, then land the next one from above
- [Swirl Dissolve](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/swirl-dissolve.md): Unwind a swirl shader open and wind it shut to reveal the next scene
- [Venetian Blinds](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/venetian-blinds.md): Split the outgoing scene into horizontal slats that turn edge-on in a staggered ripple to reveal the next one
- [Warp Dissolve](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/warp-dissolve.md): Melt the outgoing scene into a folding domain-warp field that straightens back out into the next scene
- [Wave Wipe](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/wave-wipe.md): Sweep a grainy wave up across the frame, covering the outgoing scene and revealing the next one from below
- [Whip Pan](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/whip-pan.md): Whip the camera sideways with motion blur so both scenes fly through the frame in one move
- [Zoom Blur](https://remocn.dev/docs/transitions/zoom-blur.md): Push the outgoing scene through the viewer while the incoming one resolves out of blur

## Typography
- [Blur Out Up](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/blur-out-up.md): Words arrive clean and depart upward with increasing blur for airy exits
- [Bottom-Up Letters](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/bottom-up-letters.md): Letters rise from below in a pronounced staircase, one symbol at a time
- [Caret Swap](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/caret-swap.md): A gradient caret expands into a block that consumes the first text, then types the second
- [Centered Word Build](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/centered-word-build.md): Words appear sharply from below while the centered phrase pushes closer on every beat
- [Chromatic Wave](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/chromatic-wave.md): A soft wave travels down through the type; where it crosses, the letters ripple and split into RGB fringes, then settle back to white
- [Echo Stack](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/echo-stack.md): A word focuses in at the center while outline copies of it unfold above and below and keep drifting, like the one clear line on a spinning drum
- [Extrude Pop](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/extrude-pop.md): A flat word pops up out of the plane on a solid colored 3D body, no camera involved
- [Fade Through](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/fade-through.md): Old text fades out as new fades in with a soft delay, Material-style
- [Focus Blur Resolve](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/focus-blur-resolve.md): A premium focus pull from heavy blur to crisp text, then a soft blur-out exit
- [Fog Rise](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/fog-rise.md): Display text resolves out of fog center-out, sharpening from heavy blur with vertical streaks
- [Glyph Anatomy](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/glyph-anatomy.md): A word builds as in a font editor, with metric guides, anchors along each contour and Bézier handles that pull straight segments into curves before the glyphs fill
- [Gooey Morph](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/gooey-morph.md): Bars fly in Tetris-style, land as a row, and melt into a word through a gooey blur-and-threshold morph
- [Gradient Scale Cut Text](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/gradient-scale-cut-text.md): An oversized gradient reveal snaps to a compact blurred line that settles into focus
- [Hand Count](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/hand-count.md): A number that counts up in stop-motion poses, rewritten by hand at every pose
- [Handwrite](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/handwrite.md): Handwritten text laid down letter by letter on a quantized stop-motion clock
- [Typography](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography.md): Text effects, reveals, and kinetic type for Remotion
- [Infinite Marquee](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/infinite-marquee.md): A continuously scrolling horizontal text strip that loops seamlessly
- [Ink Underline](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/ink-underline.md): A hand-dragged ink stroke that draws itself across in a few stop-motion poses
- [Inline Highlight](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/inline-highlight.md): Animate one word inside a sentence from a base color to a brand color
- [Inline Pill Takeover](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/inline-pill-takeover.md): A clipped pill expands inside a sentence, pushes the words apart, and takes over the frame
- [Inline Word Roll](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/inline-word-roll.md): Switch words beside a fixed prefix with an accelerating vertical roll
- [Kinetic Center Build](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/kinetic-center-build.md): Words enter from the right and push the line until the full phrase locks centered
- [Kinetic Morph Text](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/kinetic-morph-text.md): Letters lift, rotate, and reshape into the next phrase with delicate outline trails
- [Kinetic Warp](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/kinetic-warp.md): A coarse mesh warp bends a whole word in staccato beats, one axis moving per keyframe
- [Line-by-Line Slide](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/line-by-line-slide.md): Each line slides in from the left with a staggered flow then exits to the right
- [Marker Highlight](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/marker-highlight.md): A colored marker block draws behind a phrase while the text color shifts
- [Mask Reveal Up](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/mask-reveal-up.md): Lines reveal upward with a soft masked feel and compact stagger
- [Matrix Decode](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/matrix-decode.md): Random scramble resolves left-to-right into target text
- [Micro Scale Fade](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/micro-scale-fade.md): A calm, tiny scale pop for subtle premium polish on labels and headings
- [Number Wheel](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/number-wheel.md): Odometer that rolls a number from one value to another with direction inferred from the values
- [Outline Fill Track Text](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/outline-fill-track-text.md): A rising lead word gives way to an outlined value that fills as one continuous track moves left
- [Outline Trace](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/outline-trace.md): Every glyph contour draws itself as a stroke, letter by letter, then the fill wipes up inside each letter and the stroke fades into it
- [Path Ride](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/path-ride.md): A line draws itself along a curve with the text riding behind its head, then the curve pulls taut and the text settles on a straight, centered baseline
- [Per Character Rise](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/per-character-rise.md): Letters slide up from below with no blur - crisp and kinetic
- [Per-Word Crossfade](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/per-word-crossfade.md): One phrase fades out as the next fades in, word by word
- [Period Drop](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/period-drop.md): A word rises out of its line, then a colored dot falls from above the frame, bounces with squash and stretch, and settles as the period
- [Perspective Marquee](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/perspective-marquee.md): A 3D-tilted infinite marquee with depth-of-field blur on items rolling toward the horizon
- [Perspective Squeeze](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/perspective-squeeze.md): Two lines of heavy type endlessly trade height while corner-pinned perspective bends the flat stack into receding planes
- [RGB Glitch Text](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/rgb-glitch-text.md): Three RGB-offset text copies jitter for a few frames to create a chromatic aberration glitch
- [Ring Text](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/ring-text.md): Text runs around a tilted 3D band that spins, reading on the near side and mirrored on the far side
- [Rolling Number](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/rolling-number.md): Odometer where every place rolls at its own speed, new places rising into view, settling exactly on the target value
- [Rolodex Flip](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/rolodex-flip.md): Cycle a word through a list of values with a 3D rolodex card flip
- [Rush Type](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/rush-type.md): White words blast into vertical RGB shutter trails generated entirely by motion
- [Scale Down Fade](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/scale-down-fade.md): Subtle premium settle-in with a restrained scale-down fade on exit
- [Selection Snap](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/selection-snap.md): A thin word in a loose viewfinder snaps into a design-tool selection while it goes from Thin to Black, pops its handles and counts up a size badge
- [Shader Text Reveal](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/shader-text-reveal.md): Reveal words through the original OpenShaders hero material, then settle into white type
- [Shadow Sweep Text](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/shadow-sweep-text.md): A rising line is uncovered and removed by two dense dark shadow sweeps
- [Shared Axis Y](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/shared-axis-y.md): Per-word hard-cut staircase transition for sharp editorial phrase swaps
- [Shared Axis Z](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/shared-axis-z.md): Scale-based shared-axis transition for focus shifts and context depth
- [Sheen Slide In](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/sheen-slide-in.md): A title glides in from the right with a long settle while a gradient sheen sweeps through the glyphs
- [Shimmer Sweep](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/shimmer-sweep.md): A bright shine travels across muted text to draw attention
- [Short Slide Down](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/short-slide-down.md): Words drop in from above and stack into a centered multi-line composition
- [Short Slide Right](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/short-slide-right.md): The whole phrase glides in from the left while words reveal in sequence through opacity
- [Slot Machine Roll](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/slot-machine-roll.md): Vertical reel scrolls each character from an old value to a new value
- [Soft Blur In](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/soft-blur-in.md): Per-character fade-in with a gentle blur and upward motion
- [Spring Scale In](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/spring-scale-in.md): Words pop in with a soft overshoot scale, like a spring settling into place
- [Squeeze In](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/squeeze-in.md): Characters appear one by one, then the whole word squeezes as the last one lands
- [Staggered Fade Up](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/staggered-fade-up.md): Words slide up and fade in sequentially with a wave-like cascade
- [Stretch In](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/stretch-in.md): Letters fly in from off-canvas and smear horizontally on the way — a vertex-lag deformation, not a scale
- [Strikethrough Replace](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/strikethrough-replace.md): Draws a strike line through the old text, then fades the new text in beneath it for an editorial correction
- [Stripe Type](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/stripe-type.md): A word cut into horizontal bands, as in the IBM logo, slides together from alternating sides and locks, then can pass on through
- [Top-Down Letters](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/top-down-letters.md): Letters descend from above in a pronounced staircase, one symbol at a time
- [Tracking In](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/tracking-in.md): Letter-spacing collapses and blur clears with a springy entrance
- [Type Fossil](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/type-fossil.md): A readable word carries layers of fine contours, revises itself, then compresses into a clean typographic imprint
- [Type Repeater](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/type-repeater.md): An After Effects style repeater on a word, where copies unfold into a tunnel, a spiral or a fan behind it, breathe, then fold back into the word
- [Type Wall](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/type-wall.md): Rows of one word fill the frame, run in alternating directions at different speeds in heavy, narrow and outline faces, with an accent band through the middle
- [Typed Split Wipe](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/typed-split-wipe.md): A centered cursorless type build exits through opposing fixed-layout glyph wipes
- [Typewriter](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/typewriter.md): Character-by-character text reveal with a deterministic blinking cursor
- [Value Swap](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/value-swap.md): Swap a value in place with a vertical slide so the layout never shifts
- [Word Push](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/word-push.md): Words drive in from the right and push the line left into its new center
- [Word Stream](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/word-stream.md): Voiceover-paced phrases building word by word while the line drifts left
- [Zoom Words](https://remocn.dev/docs/typography/zoom-words.md): Huge words fade into a long line while the camera rides the write head

## Captions
- [Get a transcript](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/getting-started/get-a-transcript.md): Turn a voiceover into the timed Caption array every caption component reads
- [Introduction](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/getting-started/introduction.md): Subtitles rendered from a timed transcript, word by word, in sync with a real voiceover
- [Positioning](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/getting-started/positioning.md): Where to put the caption block in landscape and vertical video, with safe-zone numbers
- [Active Pop](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-active-pop.md): The word being spoken turns to the accent colour and springs up in scale, then settles back as the voice moves on
- [Blur In](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-blur-in.md): Each word resolves out of a soft blur the moment it is spoken, for captions that arrive quietly
- [Bounce In](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-bounce-in.md): Each word springs up into place with a little overshoot the moment it is spoken, and the phrase builds word by word
- [Cube](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-cube.md): Each new phrase turns into view as the next face of a 3D cube, the previous phrase rotating up and away on a horizontal hinge
- [Dim Progress](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-dim-progress.md): The whole phrase sits on screen dimmed and each word brightens the moment it is spoken, with no motion at all
- [Drop](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-drop.md): Each word falls into place from above and bounces as it lands the moment it is spoken, and the whole phrase drops out of frame when the speaker pauses
- [Emoji](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-emoji.md): An emoji pops up above a chosen word the moment it is spoken and stays until the phrase leaves
- [Handwrite](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-handwrite.md): Each word is inked in by hand from left to right at the pace it is spoken, every word sitting at its own slight angle
- [Highlight Box](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-highlight-box.md): A solid box travels behind the word being spoken, sliding from word to word as the voice moves on
- [Karaoke](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-karaoke.md): Each word fills with colour left to right exactly as it is spoken, with the whole phrase readable before the voice reaches it
- [Knockout](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-knockout.md): A solid plate with the words cut clean through it, each word punching out the moment it is spoken so the footage shows through the letters
- [Label Maker](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-label-maker.md): Each phrase is punched letter by letter into a strip of embossing tape at the pace it is spoken, the tape feeding out as the words arrive
- [Marker](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-marker.md): Plain captions where the words that matter get a highlighter swipe the moment they are spoken
- [Outline](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-outline.md): Heavy-stroked captions that stay readable over any footage, with the spoken word switching to a contrast colour and nothing else moving
- [Prosody](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-prosody.md): Word size follows the delivery, so drawn-out words land large and rushed words stay small, and the rhythm of the voice is visible with the sound off
- [Redact](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-redact.md): The whole phrase starts blacked out like a declassified file, and each bar pulls away the moment its word is spoken
- [Rise](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-rise.md): Each word slides up out of a mask at its baseline the moment it is spoken, with no bounce and no scale
- [Scramble](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-scramble.md): Each word arrives as random glyphs at the moment it is spoken and decodes left to right into the real letters
- [Slice](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-slice.md): Each word arrives cut in two, the top half sliding in from the left and the bottom from the right, locking together the moment it is spoken
- [Slot](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-slot.md): One short line at a time, each new phrase rolling up into place as the previous one rolls out the top
- [Speaker](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-speaker.md): Dialogue captions where every phrase takes its speaker's colour, so a conversation reads like a script
- [Split Flap](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-split-flap.md): Every letter sits on its own flap tile and clatters through a few characters before landing the moment the word is spoken, like a station departure board
- [Stack](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-stack.md): Kinetic captions stacked a couple of words per line, with the keyword of each page set large on its own line
- [Stamp](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-stamp.md): Plain captions where the words that matter slam down as a rubber stamp the moment they are spoken
- [Subtitle](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-subtitle.md): Classic broadcast subtitles, a whole phrase on a translucent plate, with no word-level animation at all
- [Teleprompter](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-teleprompter.md): The whole transcript scrolls smoothly through a short window with the current line centred, past lines fading above and the next line waiting below
- [Timeline](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-timeline.md): The whole transcript laid out on a scrolling time strip that slides under a fixed playhead, so every pause shows up as space between words
- [Typewriter](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-typewriter.md): Each word types out character by character at the pace it is spoken, with a caret that blinks while the speaker pauses
- [Underline](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-underline.md): A bar slides under the word being spoken, travelling from word to word while the text itself stays untouched
- [Weight](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-weight.md): The word being spoken swells from a light weight to a heavy one and relaxes as the voice moves on, with no layout shift
- [Word Pop](https://remocn.dev/docs/captions/components/caption-word-pop.md): One large word at a time, each popping in on a spring the moment it is spoken

## Filters
- [ASCII Render](https://remocn.dev/docs/filters/components/ascii-render.md): Redraw a live scene as ASCII, one character per cell, tracking the picture as it moves
- [Camera Lens](https://remocn.dev/docs/filters/components/camera-lens.md): Put a scene behind real glass — resolution falling toward the corners, blooming highlights, edge fringing
- [CRT Screen](https://remocn.dev/docs/filters/components/crt-screen.md): Put a scene behind curved glass — barrel distortion, phosphor mask, scanlines and a falling-away rim
- [Halftone Print](https://remocn.dev/docs/filters/components/halftone-print.md): Print a scene onto paper — rotated dot screens per colour, slightly out of register
- [Hologram](https://remocn.dev/docs/filters/components/hologram.md): Play a scene as a projection — ghost double, emission lines, only the bright parts carrying
- [Pixelate Region](https://remocn.dev/docs/filters/components/pixelate-region.md): Cover rectangles of a scene with an opaque mosaic and leave the rest untouched
- [Security Cam](https://remocn.dev/docs/filters/components/security-cam.md): Run a scene through a cheap recorder — macroblocks, collapsed colour, crushed blacks, crawling noise
- [Sustained Glitch](https://remocn.dev/docs/filters/components/sustained-glitch.md): Hold a scene under scheduled bursts of broadcast corruption, resting clean in between
- [Underwater Ripple](https://remocn.dev/docs/filters/components/underwater-ripple.md): Hold a scene under moving water — layered refraction that closes on a whole number of cycles
- [VHS Filter](https://remocn.dev/docs/filters/components/vhs-filter.md): Hold a scene under analog tape — chroma bleed, tape wobble, a head-switch tear and luma noise
- [Introduction](https://remocn.dev/docs/filters/getting-started/introduction.md): Pixel-level treatments you hold over a whole scene, built on the experimental html-in-canvas browser API

## Shaders
- [Caustics](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-caustics.md): A field of refracted light — the bright filaments light makes through a rippling surface
- [Color Panels](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-color-panels.md): Overlapping translucent color panels sliding past each other
- [Dithering](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-dithering.md): Ordered-dither shading over an animated gradient field
- [Dot Orbit](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-dot-orbit.md): Dots orbiting on concentric paths across the frame
- [Gem Smoke](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-gem-smoke.md): Animated color fields flowing behind and inside a glassy logo silhouette
- [God Rays](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-god-rays.md): Volumetric light rays radiating from an off-screen source
- [Light Tunnel](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-light-tunnel.md): Fly straight through the original OpenShaders hero field mapped into a light tunnel
- [Liquid Metal](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-liquid-metal.md): Molten metallic surface with flowing specular highlights
- [Metaballs](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-metaballs.md): Organic blobs merging and splitting like lava
- [Neuro Noise](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-neuro-noise.md): Organic neural-web noise field that slowly morphs
- [Perlin Noise](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-perlin-noise.md): Classic Perlin noise clouds drifting across the frame
- [Pulsing Border](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-pulsing-border.md): Glowing border frame that pulses around the edges
- [Simplex Noise](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-simplex-noise.md): Simplex noise flow field, smoother than Perlin
- [Smoke Ring](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-smoke-ring.md): Soft smoke ring curling and dissipating in place

- [Voronoi](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-voronoi.md): Animated Voronoi cells shifting and re-tessellating
- [Water](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-water.md): Caustic water-surface ripples with subtle refraction
- [Weave](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/components/shader-weave.md): A woven substrate of warp and weft threads crossing on a domain-warped grid
- [Introduction](https://remocn.dev/docs/shaders/getting-started/introduction.md): WebGL shader backdrops wrapped for Remotion and driven per-frame for deterministic renders
